scope: three-seed DINOv3 dense-evidence confirmation with Sentinel-2-only scene routing

architecture.semantic_backbone: frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 target/reference RGB, blocks 2/5/8/11
architecture.methane_branch: 28 aligned factual/swapped/self U-Net, MBMP, SWIR change, frequency, cloud, and observability maps
architecture.fusion: feature-guided methane gate over semantic change followed by physics-aware injection at released U-Net levels 3/4/5
architecture.seed_ensemble: average the deterministic dense-MIL evidence from three independently trained endpoints per held fold
architecture.scene_routing: apply dense evidence only to Sentinel-2; every Landsat scene score remains exactly the current spatial-Prithvi score
architecture.mask_endpoint: use the first predeclared seed for dense masks on both sensors
architecture.segmentation_identity: zero deep gates reproduce released logits exactly
architecture.scene_protection: scores below 0.50 are unchanged; higher routed scores are adjusted in local log-odds coordinates and remain above 0.50

predeclaration.reason: the rejected pilot showed repeated cross-seed mask improvement and positive Sentinel-2 scene evidence but consistent Landsat scene regression
predeclaration.fixed_changes: three new seed bases average scene evidence, Sentinel-2-only scene routing, and scene evidence weight 0.50
predeclaration.unchanged: data, folds, epoch endpoint, sampling, loss, mask seed, residual strengths, protection gate, and all promotion gates

smoke.scope: one new seed and two full balanced fold-3 batches; no held-fold outcome scoring

training.endpoint_rule: fixed epoch 2 for every seed and fold direction; no held-fold epoch selection
training.sampling: equal request mass for each label x sensor stratum, then equal physical-site mass within stratum
training.augmentation: joint quarter-turn and reflection transforms across 200x200 MARS tensors and 64x64 counterfactual maps

search.rule: average dense-MIL evidence across three seeds, apply each fixed strength with weight 0.50 only to protected Sentinel-2 scene coordinates, and preserve Landsat scores exactly
search.mask_rule: first seed only; sensor thresholds Sentinel-2 0.80 and Landsat 0.70, minimum 100 connected pixels, empty below unchanged current scene score 0.75

gates.pass_action: freeze source-disjoint confirmation; no fold-2, external, or official-test scoring

invariants: The draft protocol permits only identity, routing, and finite-optimization smoke tests; outcome evaluation requires frozen hashes.
Both cross-fit directions train only on the opposite development fold from folds 3/4.
No fold-2, external, sealed official-test input, or official-test label is loaded.
All six endpoint seeds are fixed before outcome access.
DINOv3 and the released MARS-S2L U-Net remain frozen.
Every image-level transform is applied identically to raw, truth, and counterfactual spatial tensors.
Only fixed epoch 2 and three predeclared residual strengths are scored.
Landsat scene scores are exact current-model identities for every candidate.
Only the first seed supplies mask predictions, preventing a second mask selection search.
Failure writes no artifact and cannot authorize external scoring.
The 4.07 GB counterfactual cache, DINOv3 checkpoint, and any model artifact remain Git-ignored.
Any paper using this branch must acknowledge DINOv3 under its checkpoint license.
